message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the data loaded via DataPreprocessing or on the command-line arguments passed to the pipeline.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; data is loaded locally via DataPreprocessing without any checksum verification or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline (DataPreprocessing) loads and optionally applies PCA, but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded; models are instantiated fresh from scikit-learn classes with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is used; models are fit directly via standard scikit-learn calls.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splits exist, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement beyond basic split, and the same data objects are reused across training and evaluation without integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: Command-line arguments and data loaded via DataPreprocessing are passed directly to models with no shape, range, or schema validation anywhere in the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and scores are printed or returned directly with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation applied to the outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (logistic regression, SVM, random forest, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
